description: Verify that DUT rate-limits Probe emissions to one new address per RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL after MAX_CONFLICTS = 10 conflicts (RFC 3927 §2.2.1, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.2.1 caps the rate at which a host can re-probe after collisions: once MAX_CONFLICTS = 10 conflict events have been seen, the prober MUST wait at least RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL between attempts on a fresh address. This protects the link from a thrashing prober and gives existing claimants time to settle. This case forces 10 collisions and asserts:
  • each conflict yields a fresh re-probe (LL changes every cycle), AND
  • after the 10th collision, the wire stays silent for the rate-limit interval

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (fast-conflict envelope, rate_limit_interval = 3 s)

2. Repeat 10×:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Probe (target_proto_ip = LL_k, must differ from LL_{k-1})
   • Tester → DUT: ARP Request, sender_proto_ip = LL_k

3. Observation (rate-limit silence window):
   • DUT must NOT emit any ARP for the duration of RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL

[Pass condition]
10 distinct LL re-probes AND wire silence during the rate-limit interval.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_initial_probe — DUT did not emit any initial ARP Probe within the deadline
• Fail_conflicts_incomplete — DUT did not re-probe through all MAX_CONFLICTS = 10
• Fail_cycle_repeat — DUT re-probed with the same LL it had used before (no fresh pick)
• Fail_emitted_during_silence — DUT emitted an ARP during the rate-limit silence window

verdicts.Pass: DUT enforced the RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL silence — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_initial_probe: DUT did not emit any initial ARP Probe within the deadline
verdicts.Fail_conflicts_incomplete: DUT did not re-probe through MAX_CONFLICTS = 10
verdicts.Fail_cycle_repeat: DUT re-probed with a stale (already-used) Link-Local address
verdicts.Fail_emitted_during_silence: DUT emitted an ARP during the rate-limit silence window
